reviewPrinciples: Report only findings supported by the changed files, diff, or diagnostic output.
Prefer small, actionable findings over speculative redesigns.
Do not treat generated files, lockfiles, or diagnostic noise as architectural violations by themselves.
Recommend dependency upgrades only when they add security or clear value; key-framework majors belong in a dedicated PR.
Scripture text and references must be accurate and attributed to their translation; content changes must keep the content contract passing.
Keep the app fast and accessible; daily verse delivery must be reliable.

rules.title: Keep scripture content accurate
rules.description: Verse text, references and translation attribution must match the source; content must satisfy scripts/content-contract.mjs.

rules.title: Protect user data and subscriptions
rules.description: Any email, reminder or account data must be validated, stored minimally and never exposed in logs or client bundles.

rules.title: Keep migrations safe
rules.description: Database migrations must be backward compatible and preserve existing data.

rules.title: Keep secrets out of outputs
rules.description: No secrets or tokens committed, logged or shipped to the browser.

rules.title: Keep scheduled jobs reliable
rules.description: Scheduled workflows (daily verse) must be idempotent and fail loudly.

rules.title: Preserve performance and accessibility
rules.description: Changes must not add heavy client bundles or regress accessibility of the shell.

rules.title: Avoid dependency and module cycles
rules.description: New dependencies need a clear purpose; no circular imports.
